name: Atlas of Human-AI Interaction
description: A living map of empirical findings across the human-AI interaction literature — charting what we actually know about how AI affects people.

name: Benchmarks for Human Flourishing with AI
description: Open benchmarks that evaluate AI systems by their impact on human cognitive, emotional, and social outcomes — not just model performance.

name: State of AI & Human Flourishing Survey
description: A recurring survey initiative examining how AI use relates to flourishing across populations.

name: Global Observatory for the Human Impact of AI
description: Monitoring outcomes of AI adoption worldwide, across cultures and contexts.

name: Future You
description: An interactive digital-twin system that lets people converse with their older self, shown to reduce anxiety and strengthen future self-continuity.

name: How AI Chatbots Affect Social & Emotional Wellbeing
description: A large randomized controlled study — run with OpenAI — of how conversational AI use influences loneliness, socialization, and emotional dependence.

name: My Boyfriend is AI

name: Chatbots & Loneliness in Older Adults
description: Examining whether AI chatbots relieve or deepen isolation among seniors.

name: AHA Micro Grants
description: $5,000–$10,000 seed grants for innovative projects at the intersection of AI and human flourishing.

name: Open Benchmark for the Human Impact of AI
description: An open benchmarking effort measuring AI’s human impact beyond static performance metrics — in collaboration with the Psychology of Technology Institute.

name: Global Flourishing Study
description: A $43M longitudinal study of ~200,000 people across 22 countries — the largest dataset on what makes humans flourish.

name: AI for Human Flourishing Working Group
description: Designing and testing a flourishing-grounded framework to guide decisions around AI products.

name: The Flourishing Measure
description: A validated instrument measuring flourishing across happiness, health, meaning, character, relationships, and financial stability — widely used to evaluate interventions, including AI.

name: AI Index Report
description: The annual global report tracking AI progress, adoption, and societal impact — a shared evidence base for policymakers worldwide.

name: Digital Economy Lab
description: Research on how AI transforms work, productivity, and human wellbeing across the economy.

name: World Happiness Report
description: The annual UN-partnered report ranking global happiness, produced with Gallup World Poll data.

name: Work Wellbeing Score

name: Digital Technology & Adolescent Wellbeing

name: AI & Human Values

name: Global AI Narratives
description: How different cultures imagine AI — and how those stories shape what gets built and regulated.

name: Assistance Games
description: Formal models in which AI systems learn human objectives through interaction rather than assuming them.

description: A joint initiative with the MIT Media Lab on steering AI development toward the public good.

name: AI Snake Oil

name: Governing Digital Innovation
description: Frameworks for governing AI and data technologies so they serve human dignity rather than erode it.

name: World Well-Being Project
description: Measuring psychological wellbeing at population scale from social-media language using computational methods.

name: AI Tutoring & Learning
description: Intelligent tutoring systems that measurably improve learning while keeping human agency central.

name: AI for Health & Wellbeing
description: National research applying AI to mental and physical health while safeguarding public trust.

name: AI + Human Flourishing Initiative
description: An interdisciplinary research interest group incubating AI interventions that enhance wellbeing and inner life.

name: Religion, Health & Flourishing

name: Values in the Wild

name: Anthropic Economic Index
description: Tracking how AI is changing work and the economy, from millions of real-world conversations.

name: Affective Use & Emotional Wellbeing Study

name: Expert Council on Well-Being & AI

name: The Ethics of Advanced AI Assistants

name: Habermas Machine

name: GenAI & Critical Thinking

name: New Future of Work
description: A research initiative on making AI-era work productive, equitable, and meaningful.

name: Perspective API

name: OLMo — Open Language Models
description: Fully open language models — weights, data, and training code — enabling transparent research on AI’s behavior and impact.

name: Your Undivided Attention
description: A leading podcast examining how AI and social technology shape society, attention, and wellbeing.

name: The AI Dilemma
description: A widely viewed briefing on the race dynamics of AI deployment and what it would take to develop AI responsibly.

name: Responsible Tech Guide
description: An open map of the responsible-technology ecosystem: organizations, career paths, and university programs.

name: AI & Shared Prosperity Initiative
description: Guidelines for steering AI toward expanding — not concentrating — economic opportunity.

name: Psychology of Technology Briefings
description: Translating behavioral-science research on AI and technology into guidance for designers, funders, and policymakers.

name: Youth AI Safety Institute
description: Research and evaluation hub focused on protecting young people in the age of AI, working with technical evaluators and academic partners.

name: AI Ratings & Reviews
description: Independent ratings of AI products for age-appropriateness, safety, and impact on kids.

name: Algorithmic Impact Methods
description: Developing methods to assess how automated systems affect the people and communities subject to them.

name: Landscape of AI Power
description: An annual report mapping how concentrated compute, data, and capital shape whose interests AI serves.

name: Trustworthy AI
description: Advocacy, research, and grants advancing AI that is accountable to people and communities.

name: Flourishing AI (FAI) Benchmark

name: Gallup World Poll

name: Flourishing Evaluations

name: Open Science Framework

name: Character & Virtue Development

name: People-Centered AI Grants

name: Pro-Human AI Declaration

name: AI for Global Health

name: Opportunity Onramps
description: Funding skills-based pathways into meaningful careers as AI reshapes the workforce.

name: AI for Humanity Grants
description: $73.5M in grants and data-science capacity for nonprofits using AI to expand human potential and civic wellbeing.

name: Adolescent Mental Health Innovation
description: Backing research and ventures that use technology to support — not undermine — young people’s mental health and identity.

name: OECD.AI Policy Observatory
description: A live database of AI policies and trustworthy-AI metrics across 70+ countries.

name: Public Attitudes to AI
description: Nationally representative research on how people actually feel about AI in their lives — a counterweight to industry narratives.

name: Thrive AI Health

name: Workplace Wellbeing Toolkit

name: Imagine AI

name: AI2050 Fellows

name: Responsible Technology
description: Investing in a digital society where technology strengthens agency, trust, and democratic life.

name: AI, Democracy & Local News
description: Funding research and institutions so AI strengthens — rather than corrodes — informed, engaged communities.

name: Mental Health Priority Area

name: Youth AI & Mental Health Guidance

name: Youth AI Advocacy
